name: Leaping Strike
body:
With a tremendous leap, you can both move and attack your foe.

Prerequisite: Mogogol, BAB +3

Benefit: When you charge, you may make both a bull rush and a basic melee attack, in that order.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition. Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
